units.source_text: 蒙君冷遇，使我‘不明事理枉多忧’，此外无言可奉陈也。”

en.t: Your cold treatment has made me grieve foolishly without understanding the reason; beyond this, I have nothing more to say.

units.source_text: 二女公子想不复他，又恐向无此例，侍女们要诧怪。

en.t: The Second Princess thought of not replying to him, but feared that since there had never been such a precedent, her ladies-in-waiting would find it strange.

units.source_text: 左右为难，结果略复数字：“来信拜收。

en.t: Caught between two difficulties, she finally wrote only a few words in reply: "I have respectfully received your letter.

units.source_text: 心情异常恶劣，未能详复为歉。”

en.t: I am in an exceptionally poor state of mind, and I apologize for being unable to answer in detail."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言接到回信，殊觉言语太少，甚是扫兴，只管恋恋不舍地回想她那可爱的面影。

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, received her reply, he felt deeply disappointed by how few words it contained, and could only keep thinking longingly of her lovely face.

units.source_text: 二女公子想是现已渐通人情世故，所以昨夜对薰中纳言虽然如此严拒痛斥，

en.t: The Second Princess seemed by now to have gradually come to understand the ways of the world, so although the night before she had so sternly rejected and reproached Kaoru, the Middle Counselor,

units.source_text: 但并不十分嫌恶，态度非常稳静，且又温和婉转，终于推三托四，巧妙地把他送走。

en.t: she did not truly loathe him; her manner was very calm, gentle, and tactful, and in the end she skillfully sent him away with one excuse after another.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言现在回想她那模样，心中又是嫉妒，又是悲伤，百感交集，愁闷不已。

en.t: Now, as Kaoru recalled her appearance, jealousy and sorrow mingled in his heart; a hundred feelings crowded together, leaving him sunk in misery.

units.source_text: 他想：“此人比较起从前来，样样都长进了。

en.t: He thought, "Compared with before, she has improved in every way.

units.source_text: 将来匂亲王抛弃了她，叫她依靠我就是了。

en.t: In the future, when Prince Niou abandons her, I need only have her depend on me.

units.source_text: 那时我虽然不能公然泰然地和她做夫妻，但可暗中往来。

en.t: At that time, though I may not be able to live openly and calmly with her as husband and wife, I can visit her in secret.

units.source_text: 我又别无心爱之人，就叫她做我惟一的终身伴侣吧。”

en.t: Since I have no other beloved, I will make her my one companion for life."

units.source_text: 他只管筹划此事，其用心实在太不成样了。

en.t: He went on planning only this, and the intention behind it was truly disgraceful.

units.source_text: 此人本来非常聪明正直，然而男子的心原都是可恶的。

en.t: This man was originally very intelligent and upright, yet men's hearts are, by nature, all hateful things.

units.source_text: 悲伤大女公子之死，虽然已徒劳无益，但并不像此次之痛苦。

en.t: His grief over the First Princess's death, though already futile and useless, had not been like the pain he felt this time.

units.source_text: 而此次呢，愁绪万叠，回肠百转，其苦不可言喻。

en.t: This time, however, grief piled upon grief, his heart twisted again and again, and the suffering was beyond words.

units.source_text: 他听见人说：“今天匂亲王到二条院了。”

en.t: He heard someone say, "Today Prince Niou has gone to Nijo-in."

units.source_text: 便忘记了自己是二女公子娘家的后援人，顿时妒火中烧，心痛欲裂。

en.t: At once he forgot that he himself was the supporter of the Second Princess's natal family; jealousy flared up inside him, and his heart felt as if it would split with pain.
